label: Dual wing with cross circulation
rationale: Circulation runs east-west across the plot in a 7800 mm band, splitting the dwellings into a north wing and a south wing. Flats are entered from their long side, so the living and sleeping bands run across the plot rather than down it and each flat presents a full-width exterior facade.
